Direct image appearance and existing action/state/oracle declarations are separated. Logical 618 x 824 candidates and the 1236 x 1648 related reference do not qualify physical native scale, rotation, sleep/wake, e-ink effects, performance, genuine reader leases, hidden footer-cycle behavior or physical hit regions.

Eight assigned originals were opened within four pairs. No additional images, crops, image processing, hashes, validators, application execution or SSH were used. This report does not accept the full module or full run; reconciliation to the final required manifest remains outside this batch.
